name: Pemba

queries.query: Pemba Mozambique official cadastral map parcel registry GIS API
queries.result: Official discovery found the Pemba municipal IPRA page, the municipal neighborhood map, the national ADE/MOZGIS portal, and Mozambique's SIRP/Predial registry entry points. No public anonymous Pemba parcel service or parcel response was exposed.

queries.query: Pemba Moçambique cadastro mapa de parcelas registo predial SIG oficial
queries.result: A pesquisa oficial em português encontrou o mapa municipal de bairros, o IPRA municipal, a ADE/Rede Nacional SIG e o portal de Registos e Notariado. O catálogo público MOZGIS retornou serviços cadastrais de Vilankulo e Matola, mas não um item Pemba; não foi obtida resposta anónima segura de ID e geometria de parcela.

researchNote: Official local municipal mapping and property-tax/procedure evidence were found, and a national public GIS catalog was inspected. No Pemba parcel layer with safe native identity plus geometry was qualified. This packet is not source integration or runtime admission.
